Electricity bought is only 0.19x the minimum needed for the tonnes claimed (57 kWh/t against at least 300)
Certificates claim more than the declared monthly capacity in 27% of months
Sold products equal only 12% of the output expected from the tonnes claimed

69% of certificate tonnes were generated more than 45 days after the processing month

inspection_checklist: Obtain the DISCOM consumption statement and meter readings for the flagged months; compare connected machinery (kW) against the claimed tonnage.
Check installed machinery and shift records against the declared capacity; request production registers for the flagged months.
Reconcile product sales with processed tonnes; contact the product buyers listed and verify that they received the material.
Cross-check the certificate generation dates and category mix against the plant's process route and stock registers.
